# Psalm 124 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Of-David. If-not YHWH who-was for-us — let-say now Israel —

**2** If-not YHWH who-was for-us, when-rose against-us men,

**3** Then alive they-would-have-swallowed-us, when-burned their-anger against-us.

**4** Then the-waters would-have-engulfed-us, the-torrent would-have-passed over our-soul.

**5** Then would-have-passed over our-soul the-waters the-raging.

**6** Blessed YHWH, who not gave-us as-prey to-their-teeth.

**7** Our-soul like-a-bird has-escaped from-snare-of the-fowlers; the-snare is-broken and-we have-escaped.

**8** Our-help in-name-of YHWH, maker-of heaven and-earth.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **124:7**: 'The-snare is-broken and-we have-escaped' — one of the Psalter's most vivid images of deliverance; the trapped bird suddenly set free.

— EMET
